strict_empirical_criterion.formula: C_strict = G AND D AND R AND H AND V AND A AND M

components.R: replication of the functional genetic program
components.H: transmission of that program into daughter compartments
components.V: heritable variation causing differential descendant production
components.A: no experimenter-scheduled per-generation extrusion, lysis/re-encapsulation, or adaptive reset

strict_empirical_criterion.reason: No primary study reviewed here jointly closes autonomy, recursive full-program heredity, and endogenous adaptive evolution.

strongest_current_empirical_statement: An externally coordinated integrated synthetic-cell cycle is reported in the 2026 SpudCell preprint. A lineage jointly satisfying autonomous recurrence, robust full-genome inheritance, and endogenous evolution has not been demonstrated.

primary_literature.title: Self-reproduction of supramolecular giant vesicles combined with the amplification of encapsulated DNA
primary_literature.scope: one-generation coupling of DNA amplification, vesicle growth/division, and DNA distribution to daughters

primary_literature.title: A recursive vesicle-based model protocell with a primitive model cell cycle
primary_literature.scope: externally stimulated recursive model protocell; the article explicitly distinguishes it from a living cell

primary_literature.title: Darwinian Evolution of Self-Replicating DNA in a Synthetic Protocell
primary_literature.observed: Phi29 self-replicating DNA accumulated environment-specific advantageous mutations over 10-12 experimental rounds
external_operations: intermittent route: lysis, PCR, optional gel purification, and re-encapsulation each round
semi-continuous route: dilution with feeder vesicles and freeze-thaw redistribution
primary_literature.scope: molecular-replicator evolution in compartments, not a growing and dividing cell lineage

primary_literature.title: Self-growing protocell models in aqueous two-phase system induced by internal DNA replication reaction
primary_literature.observed: DNA-replication-driven DEX-droplet growth, including approximately 1.8-fold volume growth in the recursive-replication configuration

primary_literature.title: A synthetic cell with integrated DNA self-replication and lipid biosynthesis
primary_literature.observed: a 9.6-kb self-replicating genome and DOPS biosynthesis operated together in individual liposomes
primary_literature.reported_bottleneck: new DOPS was below 7% of total lipid and did not support detectable membrane expansion or division

primary_literature.title: A Chemically Defined Synthetic Cell Capable Of Growth And Replication

mechanical_cycle_observed.resource_replenishment: fresh feeder liposomes carrying PURE components, enzymes, small molecules, and membrane lipids each generation
mechanical_cycle_observed.selection: an intentionally installed stronger T7Max promoter produced more descendants than the weaker T7 promoter

primary_literature.scope: closest integrated cell-cycle realization, but preprint evidence remains externally scheduled and the beneficial promoter variant was introduced rather than arising spontaneously

primary_literature.title: Division of Synthetic Cells Using a Genomically Encoded One-Protein Divisome
primary_literature.observed: cell-free expression of DynA or its D1 domain drove scission of membrane necks
primary_literature.scope: a division-module existence result, not a complete recursive cell cycle

equation_to_experiment_boundary.E_t: fixed environmental resource and forcing law
equation_to_experiment_boundary.U_t: experimenter-scheduled extrusion, pH jumps, lysis/re-encapsulation, or staged reagent additions
equation_to_experiment_boundary.autonomy_gate: U_t must be absent or generated by a fixed environment law independent of experimenter observation of the state
equation_to_experiment_boundary.consequence: The exact certificate proves a chemostatted mathematical recurrence, not empirical autonomy.
